 AND p.game_count = m.max_game_count
ORDER BY p.release_year, p.platform_id;

tool_arguments.sql:
WITH platform_counts AS (
    SELECT release_year, platform_id, COUNT(game_publisher_id) AS game_count
    FROM game_platform
    GROUP BY release_year, platform_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT release_year, platform_id,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY release_year ORDER BY game_count DESC) AS rnk
    FROM platform_counts
)
SELECT release_year, platform_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY release_year, platform_id;
